description: Plan, write, and schedule a week of on-brand social media content for your business through the Marky API. Use this when you want a full week of posts produced and queued with one conversation: it mines real material from your own notes and updates, drafts in your voice, shows you everything for approval, then schedules across every platform you have connected. Always gets your approval before anything is scheduled. Uses the marky-api and schedule-posts skills to talk to Marky. Also triggers on "plan my week", "fill my queue", "what should I post this week", "post for me every day". For one-off posts, see schedule-posts; for ideas only, see suggest-topics.
